name: Best Ever Chili (No Bacon)

components.name: Chili

ingredients.name: Black beans, drained and rinsed (15 oz can)
Red kidney beans, drained and rinsed (15 oz can)

steps: Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot, then soften diced onion and pepper 5–6 minutes. This replaces the original bacon-rendering step.
Stir in garlic and the minced beef. Break up the beef and cook until no longer pink. Drain excessive fat if needed.
Cook tomato paste and the cumin, chilli powder, paprika and oregano briefly with the beef until aromatic.
Add the tomatoes and their juices, both drained beans, stock and bay leaf.
Bring to a gentle simmer, reduce heat and cook uncovered 30–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick.
Remove bay leaf and taste for salt and heat. For smoky flavour without bacon, adjust smoked paprika rather than adding cured meat.
Portion into six bowls; cool quickly and freeze any servings intended for later in the week.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Optional garnish: avocado, red onion, shredded cheese or sour cream (not included in the macros).
Freezer: Freeze in portions for 2–3 months for quality.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
